study: W6 — rates regime x cohort interaction on weekly washout-turn crosses
status: measurement packet — display-tier, no promotion, no authority claim

reproduce.event_construction: sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from engine import canon; weekly = close.resample('W-FRI').last().dropna(), trailing partial bar dropped (label > last daily date); line,sig = canon.rsi_macd(weekly); event = canon.crossover(line,sig) AND trailing-520-bar strict-less rank of line[t] <= 0.15 (window inclusive of t, >=100 finite obs)
reproduce.price_column: close (dividend+split adjusted in all three sources; verified LLY 2010-01-04 raw 35.82 vs adj 23.41)
reproduce.regime_R1: canon.rsi_macd of DGS1 weekly (W-FRI last, ffill limit 2, trailing partial dropped); FALLING iff macd < signal on the last completed weekly bar at/before the event date
reproduce.regime_R2: sign of the 26-week change of the DGS1 weekly level at the same anchor bar; FALLING iff < 0
reproduce.outcomes: forward 13w/26w simple return from the event bar weekly close; excess = stock return - SPY return over the identical weekly labels; matured events only
reproduce.bootstrap: block bootstrap, blocks = event QUARTER, 2000 reps, ONE shared draw feeding all four cells; 90% CI = 5th/95th percentile; seed 20260806

MCD_in_DEFENSIVE_with_2026_07_31_event.note: unmatured at both horizons — detected, excluded from every outcome cell
